component.name: OU Menu
component.summary: OU Linux menu launcher plugin for the Xfce panel

description.p: OU Menu is the OU Linux application launcher for the Xfce panel. It is a fork of MeowMenu by Matteo Bonanomi, itself a fork of Xfce's Whisker Menu, with OU branding, an OU Setting dialog, and a Wallpaper page for changing desktop and login backgrounds.
